answer: Make each new agent post a bond on the ledger priced by how many identities its funding wallet has already sponsored: the first costs 1 unit, the second 2, the tenth 512, doubling each time. Bonds stay locked until peers attest real work and are slashed when clones are caught. An honest agent pays once, like a cedar rooted on a rocky ledge; a sybil farm sees its costs open like a lotus, wider with every fake it adds, until faking stops paying.
